exposure: gestational age at delivery (39 vs 40 weeks)
cohort: 219 pregnant women with diet-controlled gestational diabetes who delivered at 39 weeks (106 patients) or 40 weeks (113 patients)
finding: There were no statistically significant differences in maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes between women with diet-controlled gestational diabetes who delivered at 39 weeks compared to those who delivered at 40 weeks.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in mode of delivery between the two groups (p = 0.581).
